verdict.rationale: The evidence shows building blocks rather than a true automation feature. The Batch API processes requests asynchronously, and server-side agentic tools (web search, code execution, remote MCP, multi-agent research) let the model take multi-step actions on its own within a request. Nothing documents user-configurable automations that run unattended, so the developer must build the scheduling and orchestration themselves. Missing for 10: scheduled or recurring tasks, event triggers, persistent background agents, a managed automation setup flow, and hands-on corroboration of unattended runs.
